content: The fastest animal in the world is the peregrine falcon. When in a dive to catch its prey, it can reach speeds of over 240 miles per hour (386 kilometers per hour). If we're talking about level flight, the Brazilian free-tailed bat holds the record, flying at speeds of over 99 miles per hour (160 kilometers per hour). Among land animals, the cheetah is the fastest, capable of reaching speeds up to 60–70 miles per hour (97–113 kilometers per hour) in short bursts covering distances up to 1,500 feet (460 meters).
